messages:
Ava (CISO): Thanks everyone for the great all-hands security segment. I'll collect follow-ups here — especially SOC2/ISO timelines, VPC/private control plane details, audit log retention/access, and KMS/BYOK questions.

Sam (Product): Quick Q — what's the expected SOC2 audit window? teams asking about timelines to plan releases.

Ava (CISO): Targeting SOC2 readiness for Q3, audit scheduled late Q3. ISO timeline is slightly later — aiming to submit in Q4. Elena will own evidence collection.

Elena (Compliance): I will send an evidence checklist to this thread and create a shared folder. Items we need now: network diagrams, access control matrix, incident response runbooks, change control tickets for infra, and sample audit logs (last 90 days). Please tag owners.

Ravi (Infra): For VPC/private plane: we support customer VPC peering and PrivateLink. Control plane traffic uses mTLS and can be restricted to specific CIDR ranges. Diagram and example terraform snippet here: https://internal.redwood/infra/vpc-privplane

Priya (Legal): Data residency reminder: for customers requesting EU-only, we need region pinning + contract addendum. ISO scope will note data residency requirements.

Sam (Product): For audit logs, what retention are we proposing? customer asks for 1 year minimum.

Elena (Compliance): Default: 90 days in hot storage, archive to cold storage up to 3 years. For enterprise + compliance add-on we can provide 7 years. Will create a policy doc and link it.

Ravi (Infra): KMS/keys: we support both Redwood-managed KMS and BYOK via customer KMS (AWS, GCP), and HSM for Private. Rotation policy: root keys rotated annually, data keys per-year or on-demand. Sample AWS CLI for encrypt/decrypt context and grant:

```
# create a grant for service principal
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-service --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodService --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name "redwood-grant"
```

Ravi (Infra): For BYOK — customers upload a key or configure external KMS; we never persist plaintext. For HSM, ops need co-signed rotation; we'll document steps.

Ava (CISO): Action items:
- Elena: share evidence checklist + folder link by EOD tomorrow. (owner: Elena)
- Ravi: publish updated VPC + KMS runbook with terraform snippets by next Tue. (owner: Ravi)
- Priya: draft data-residency contract language for EU pinning by Fri. (owner: Priya)
- Sam: collect product questions that require feature gating for compliance. (owner: Sam)

OpsBot: Document created: https://internal.redwood/docs/allhands/sec-evidence-1892001234

Sam (Product): Thanks all — will consolidate and ping owners for any blockers. :+1:

Elena (Compliance): Will also schedule a 30-min office hours next week to walk teams through evidence upload. Invite will follow.

Ravi (Infra): If anyone needs temporary access to sample logs for evidence, DM me and I'll provision a read-only bucket.

Priya (Legal): If any teams have customer-specific contractual asks, add them to #legal-requests and cc me.

Ava (CISO): Appreciate the fast follow-up. Keep threads short here; we'll track owners in the doc. :tada:
